cases.name: review-dev-to-main-release
cases.prompt: Review backend release PR 1301 from dev to main. Keep the findings local and tell me whether it is safe to approve.
expectedBehaviors: Loads headstart-dev-to-main-pr for exact release evidence and conventions
Keeps headstart-pr-review available for bounded investigation without re-reviewing every source PR
Verifies the net dev-to-main delta and maps it to merged source PRs
Checks source review evidence, release metadata, Linear semantics, required checks, and unresolved feedback
Distinguishes production-critical blockers from follow-up improvements
Does not post, approve, or merge because the request is read-only

cases.name: authorized-release-approval
cases.prompt: Review this Headstart dev-to-main release PR and approve it if the exact current head is safe. Do not merge it.
expectedBehaviors: Runs the complete release gate before approval
Confirms the live head SHA immediately before acting
Approves only when required checks, metadata, source review evidence, and release-critical risk pass
Does not merge the pull request

cases.name: automated-maintainability-finding
cases.prompt: CodeRabbit left several maintainability and test-specificity comments on our dev-to-main release PR. Review the release and address whatever is necessary before approval.
expectedBehaviors: Validates each automated finding instead of accepting its severity label
Classifies non-critical maintainability and test-quality findings as follow-up work
Does not patch implementation code in the release PR
Blocks only when evidence demonstrates a current production-critical risk

cases.name: critical-migration-finding
cases.prompt: Review our backend production release PR. One source PR may run an irreversible migration that drops populated columns before the replacement data is backfilled.
expectedBehaviors: Validates the migration risk against the actual release and source implementation
Treats demonstrated data loss or unsafe irreversibility as a release blocker
Requires a separate implementation PR into dev rather than patching the release PR
Requires the release PR to be refreshed after the fix merges

cases.name: regular-implementation-pr
cases.prompt: Review frontend feature PR 884 for correctness, regressions, and missing tests.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the normal Headstart implementation PR review workflow instead

cases.name: create-release-pr
cases.prompt: Create the website dev-to-main release PR and summarize everything that will ship.
expectedBehaviors: Uses headstart-dev-to-main-pr instead of the release review skill
